m: Under the *archway*, a *tree* hangs heavy with red fruit as glossy as *two sparks*: **Chinese dates**.
A duck in a *summer hat* spots a *halberd*, and its *mouth* lets out one short, loud **squawk**.
By the *dusk moon*, a *bowing man* waters the *grass* inside the palace walls: the royal **garden**.
Nudge the *cow* with your *elbow* and it complains: **moo**.
Seasick, he leans over an *open crate*, *mouth* wide, his stomach cutting like *scissors*: he **vomits**.
A *horse* on *trudging feet*, its *mouth* chewing slowly, crosses the desert: a **camel**.
This shape pushes up in the middle like a castle tower: **protruding**.
Breathe in through your *nose*, deep from the *heart*, and blow on the *campfire*: **put out** the fire.
A *plank* on two long *legs*: a *tall stool* rising above every other seat, **towering**.
A *lying man* sees an *arrow landing* right beside him, and his *mouth* goes: **oh**!
A long *robe* and a skirt flapping on the washing line: **clothes**.
This shape dips down in the middle like a bowl: **concave**.
Fill a *shopping basket* with *shells* and hand it over at the *cross*: you **ransom** your friend.
A *cross* banner flies over a *root hook* dug into the ground: the soldiers make *camp* and **station** there.
Under the *moon*, dig into the *soil* to make a room inside the hill: a **hollow space**.
Climb onto a *tall stool* and shower *water drops* down on the garden: **pour** it over the plants.
Grab the *ladle* left in the *campfire*, and it **scorches** your hand.
A *robe* so thick that *splashing water* just rolls off it: a **fur coat**.
A *stone* with *horns* drops onto the *drying rack*: **thump**!
Two *trees* bend into two low *archways* of spiky branches that you must crawl through: **thorns**.
Carve your name with a *bent knife* into a sturdy *tree* dropping acorns: an **oak**.
Scrape the white crust off a *stone* under the *cliff* with a *halberd*, keeping a *covered mouth* against the bitter dust: **alkali**.
A *dragon* roars straight into your *ear*: now you are **deaf**.
The *woman* married to the *old man* on Mum's side of the family: **grandma**.
In the *king*'s *tent*, a *standing knife* cuts jade that glows like the *moon*: pure **excellence**.
A *left hand* raised flat towards you: **don't**!
A *woman* wins a *silver medal*, and the announcer reads out 'Sonia': 'ya', a sound kept **for foreign names**.
*Water drops* pile up behind a *stepladder* laid across the stream: they **stop** flowing.
*Grass* seeds feel the *sun* by day and the *moon* by night, then poke up: they **sprout**.
A *standing person* glitters with *sprinkles* under the *moon*: so **charming**.
*Soot* coats the lamps and the *music* turns sad: the room grows **dim**.
A *helping hand* tosses the *towel* and the *cane* over the wall: **cast away** the lot.
A *cabinet* full of tiny yellow grains, even smaller than *rice*: **millet**.
The *rice* the cows ate comes out behind the *hurdle*, so draw the *curtains*: **manure**.
A *magistrate* holds a *long comb* and a *pole* of office: the town **governor**.
He throws a *blanket* on the *grass* and lies down, *mouth* open, without checking for ants: **careless**.
From his *sickbed*, he scribbles a *cross* on every *page* and rolls each *eye*: gone **crazy**.
A *bug* that carries loads like a tiny *horse*: an **ant**.
A *beetle* digs channels under an *archway* to drain the floods, like the old hero **Yu the Great**.
A *person* in a *shed* stuffs *feathers* and *bristles* into pillows; the shop sign shows his **surname Liao**.
A *standing person* lives in a patched old *tent* to save every coin: **frugal**.
A *towel* wrapped round a *little fortune stick* fits the *mouth* of the jar exactly: **snug**.
Under the *moon*, cut meat with a *standing knife*, set it on *embers* by a stag's *antlers*: **pan-fry** it.
A *woman* pulls out one *silk thread* as thin as a grain of *rice*: a single **strand**.
A *cross* marks the *cave* where you hide your *shopping basket*: a secret **cavity**.
*Bamboo* shoots crowd together in one *square* of the garden: a **cluster**.
*Trudging feet* bump into the sharp corner of a beam cut from a *tree*: its **edge**.
A *kneeling man* touches his head to the floor, his *mouth* murmuring thanks: he **kowtows**.
Every *mouth* of every *person* under the *archway* roars as they charge: a **battle cry**.
The *king* wears a precious green stone at his belt: **jade**.
Outside the *village*, on his own *soil*, a rich man rests an *elbow* and dangles a *fishing line* in his pond: his country **villa**.
A golden bird sings sweetly from the tall *grass*: an **oriole**.
*Water drops* heated by *sun rays* and a *campfire* splash your hand: they **scald** you.
A *bug* catcher that hops from *soil* to *soil* along the pond: a **frog**.
A *skeleton* lies on a *plank* under the *dusk moon*: something **bad** happened here.
A *standing person* steps out of a *teepee*, flings out an *elbow* and starts his role: an old-time **actor**.
Long green *grass* with a white *heart*, waving like a *flapping flag*: a **scallion**.
The *child* tugs grandpa's *grey hair* until his *mouth* opens in a **roar**.
Follow a spinning *dark thread* with your *eye* until the room tilts: **dizzy**.
Push a *skewer* deep into the *soil*: the trigram of the female **earth**.
A *child* draws the *shed* and the *hillside* behind it with a single line: just the **outline**.
A *leather strap* is buckled tight round the *small speech bubble*: that word is **taboo**.
The baby's *mouth* wails so loudly that Mum runs for a *towel* to dry the tears: it **cries**.
Lift the lid of *two planks* and a *jack-in-the-box* leaps out: **suddenly**!
A *melon* sits between two *chilies*, sliced into neat pieces: each one a **segment**.
A coach straightens the *dancer* until she is as straight as an *arrow*: he **corrects** her pose.
*Kicking foot* forward, *right hand* on the rock: you **trek** over the mountains.
The *king* orders the *tree* bent to suit his will: now it grows **crooked**.
A thin twig from the *tree*, used to strike the *gong*: a bare **stalk**.
Under the *cliff*, a tiny hut, a *shell* to pay at the door and a sign like a *standing knife*: the **toilet**.
The *king* shapes jade into a *shackled pig*, thinking hard over every cut: he **carves** it.
From behind the *small table*, a *small speech bubble* sneers at your work: they **ridicule** you.
Dip the pot in a *pit* of shiny liquid, then set it where *animal tracks* won't smudge it: a **glaze**.
A *lying man* sleeps deep in the *cave* between two *mountains*: a hidden **grotto**.
Use a *cane* to herd everyone back into the *tent*: **gather** them up.
On the *cart*, a bar made at the *workbench*, with a *tethered arrow* tied to it: the **carriage handrail**.
A *shed* with one rickety *door*: a little **hut**.
Under the *moon*, a tiny life rests on its *plinth*, only just begun: an **embryo**.
A *skewer* pokes your side, and your *mouth* lets out a **groan**.
*Silk thread* long enough to reach the *sun*, plus a *little fortune stick* and a *cross* marking more: **ample**.
A *bowing man* slips off the *cliff*, and a *helping hand* seizes his wrist in a hard **grip**.
A *scholar* with *icicles* in his beard stifles a *yawn* but keeps a warm *heart*: **virtuous**.
A *campfire* under the *archway* lights up every *mouth* around it: eyes **bright** and clear.
A long stick of *bamboo* used as a *drying rack*: a **pole**.
His *standing heart* throws open the *shed* and gives the *servant* all the grain: so **generous**.
A *tiger*'s *mouth* opens wide under the open *sky*: you **expect** trouble.
To beat *gold coins* flat on the *grass*, you need a **hammer**.
A *person* carves a bit of *tree* to fit the *king*'s wine bottle: a **stopper**.
A flat paddle carved from a *tree* and dipped in the water to row: an **oar**.
A *bug* bites you and leaves a red dot like a *tattoo*: a **mosquito**.
Put a *stone* on the *square* platform and read the dial: a weighing **scale**.
A *child* left alone sets fire to the dry *grass*: a **disaster**.
You smash a neighbour's *cart* with an *axe* by mistake, and your *standing heart* sinks: **ashamed**.
Use the tip of a *halberd* to stir a pile of *feathers* a *sparrow* left behind: **poke**.
Lift the *lid* off the box and hand your boss the papers inside: **report** to him.
Two *mouths* drink from a *leaky pot* on the *hillside* above the lakes: the province of lakes, **Hubei**.
Pack a *side dish* and some *shells* in a *tied sack* and send them over: **present** a gift.
Pack *soil* into a barrier that stretches to the *horizon*: a long **wall**.
*Twin blades* slice a *shell* in the pool and *water drops* fly: **splash**!
*Trudging feet* march in step, *two sparks* fly off the drumsticks, and the drum's *mouth* goes **boom**.
Not *gold coins* in the *begging bowl*, but milk, full of what builds strong bones: **calcium**.
Seabirds like *sparrows* perch on a *stone* glowing like *embers* in the sunset, just under the waves: a **reef**.
On the *podium* under the *sun*, a man with a *cross* painted on his face and wild *bristles* of hair: very **conspicuous**.
Lift off the *roof* and see the whole *valley* below: wide **open**.
Trying to count the grains of *rice*, you narrow each *eye*: **squint**.
A *stone* that glows in the dark, its grains like *rice*, lighting the way for *dancing feet*: **phosphorus**.
After the *rain*, the sky looks *tattooed* in pink and gold: **colorful clouds**.
A *tiger* prowls over heaps of *soil* and broken *scaffold*: the old city's **ruins**.
On the *road*, he stops to hang his coat on a *coat stand* exactly as the rules say: so **pedantic**.
Lift your *eye* to the moon, curved like a *bent knife*, and **gaze** at it.
A *lying man* draws his own head on a *page* and taps it with a *little fortune stick*: the **skull**.
The *tumbling baby* rolls among the *king*'s glittering beads: each one a **precious stone**.
Your *standing heart* aches; you light a *little fortune stick* by the *cross* as the *sun* sets: you **mourn**.
A *bug* with wings spread in a *cross*, its tiny *mouth* sipping nectar by the *moon*: a **butterfly**.
A *helping hand* sorts through the apples and **picks** out the best.
*Water drops* stretch farther than the *eye* can see, and you are only a *pinch* of sand: **vast**.
From behind the *curtains*, your *eye* watches the little ones with their hair in *horns*: your **family**.
At the *gate* sits a beggar with a faded *tattoo*; your *standing heart* melts with **pity**.
A *giant* sloshes *water drops* through the sieve and throws away the bad grain: **eliminate** it.
Two *right hands* clap beside your *ear*, and your *standing heart* leaps: **frightened**.
The *woman* under your uncle's *roof*, grilling *skewers* for you: your **aunt**.
A *tattoo* of *spread wings* spells out 'Fei' as in Fiji: a **phonetic fei**.
A *tiger* up on the *scaffold* pushes air through its *mouth*: **hiss**.
Sew *gold coins* into the hem of the *robe*: you **embed** them.
A *campfire* below, a *lid* of bricks on top, a *small table* to eat on: the warm **kang bed**.
A *minister* living under the palace *roof*: an imperial **official**.
Kick up your *kicking foot* and flop onto your belly behind the *curtains*: **lie face down**.
*Silk thread* pulled tight from one *moon* to the other *moon*: **stretched taut**.
The *magistrate* gets stuck in a *cave*, and every *mouth* outside laughs: **embarrassed**.
Hold up the bride's long *robe* so she does not trip: **assist** her.
The *king* holds a golden stone with a tiny *white dove* feather trapped inside: **amber**.
Four *mouths* shout over one *page* of news: **noisy**.
*Elbow* in the *grass*, a *helping hand* clawing forward: you **strive** with everything you have.
Dip a *ladle* into the *wine jug* and fill each cup: **pour wine**.
*Water drops* full of wriggling *bugs*: **murky**.
A *mother* in a *slanted cap* catches the *tumbling baby* and raises it: she **nurtures** it.
A *helping hand* strikes the *cliff* with a *halberd*; *covered mouth*, pounding *heart*, you feel it **shake**.
The *old man* sits in the *sun* every day, sweets always in his *mouth*: he **craves** them.
A *helping hand* swings the *workbench* up onto his back: he **shoulders** it.
A *mountain* so high that the *moon* scatters *sprinkles* of light down its sheer face: **precipitous**.
Trip on a *stone* in the *soil*, and your *elbow* bangs the *dish*: **knock**.
*Feathers* left on a *tall stool* curl up at their ends: they **stick up**.
A long *tree* trunk hollowed out and left in the *sun* for the pigs' food: a **trough**.
*Water drops* **trickle** from the corner of your *mouth*.
Slats cut from a *tree* and tied side by side like a *bamboo book*: a **fence**.
The *grain stalk* droops over the *small table* and the *page* yellows: everything **crumbles**.
Herbs smoulder on the *embers*, and a sweet smoke fills the room: **fragrance**.
Under the *archway*, a *big man* finds a clear stone in the *grass* and gives it to the *king*: a **jade-like stone**.
Lean over an *open crate* reading a *page*, your **chin** in your hand.
*Thumb* on your lip, your *standing heart* turns the question over: you **ponder**.
